label: First-mover constitutive-content and…: For every existing-interface first mover f and each respect…
definition: For every existing-interface first mover f and each respect r, content (essence f) r ↔ InAct f r, with exactly the same InAct predicate as every-perfection.
note: Open analyst interface. Formal essence differences need not imply absence of an eminent perfection; q4a2 obj2 and reply1–2 require this sense issue to remain explicit. The paired model controls demonstrate independent failure, not a metaphysical possibility.
